notes:
Short summary: Borealis builds an AI-first ticket routing and deflection layer used by 120+ mid-market customers. Primary ask: replace current keyword + TF-IDF search with embedding-based RAG to deflect tickets and surface top-5 relevant KB articles for agents. Must hit tight latency SLOs — interactive agent UI requires p95 end-to-end <=250ms for retrieval+rerank at peak. Cost is a major gating factor; finance expects <$0.03/handled-ticket query at scale.

Discovery highlights: trialed an open-source vector DB but rerank quality and operational overhead are blockers. They prefer a vendor that offers unified runtime (hosted with VPC) and measurable cost/perf tradeoffs. Strong preference for deterministic fallback (smaller quantized model) during outages.

Direct quote from Head of Ops: "If the top-5 are noisy our CSAT drops — we need rerank precision not just recall."

Typical shorthand in our notes: p95 <=250ms, target QPS 250-400 at peak, index target 12M historic tickets now, plan to grow to ~40M within 18 months. POC scope: ingest 2.5M sampled docs, evaluate recall@5 and rerank precision@5, measure cost/query with Redwood Optimize suggestions.

technical_requirements: Must support embeddings at scale (baseline 12M vectors, scale to 40M). Retrieval pipeline: ANN index + fast candidate generation (<100ms), neural reranker to score top-50 and return top-5 within p95 250ms. Need configurable rerank model size (quantized fallback) and transparent cost profiling. KMS for key control, retention controls, AD/SSO integration.
poc_success_criteria: 1) recall@5 >= 0.92 and precision@5 >= 0.85 on labeled ticket test set; 2) end-to-end p95 latency (retrieve + rerank) <=250ms at 300 QPS mixed traffic; 3) cost per handled-ticket query <= $0.03 with recommendations from Redwood Optimize; 4) Pass infosec checklist (SOC2 + SSO + audit logs).
arch_preferences: Prefer Hosted API with VPC peering for initial POC; dedicated GPU pools for production if latency/cost tradeoffs justify. Want autoscaling policy for morning spikes and predictable reserved capacity for peak 400 QPS.
open_questions: Exact shard/replica guidance for 40M vectors? Best rerank model size vs accuracy tradeoff (8-bit quant vs fp16)? Nightly batch reindex latency window and hot-update strategy?
commercial_notes: Interested in 12-month committed Dedicated plan if POC hits SLOs. Procurement expects T&Cs on data residency (US only) and incident response SLA. Estimated ARR range is $75k-$250k depending on reserved capacity mix.
recent_feedback: SE observed that simple dot-product retrieval gets high recall but rerank is the differentiator. Controller team: "We can accept slightly higher tail latency for embedding generation if rerank stays fast."
implementation_risks: 1) Index growth causing increased lookup latency unless sharding tuned; 2) Reranker compute cost could blow past budget without quantization/batching; 3) Legal requires explicit residency clause which may push to Private deployment.
